name: Ecchi na Onee-san ga Home Helper ni Nattara ~Kyonyuu de Kirei na Onee-san ga Tsukushite Agechau~
original_name: エッチなお姉さんがホームヘルパーになったら ～巨乳で綺麗なお姉さんがつくしてあげちゃう～
source:
"Oh yeah, we've got a home helper coming today, so say hello!"

"A home helper... We don't need a so-called nanny in our house!" 

I am a mother-con, I love my mother and can't get enough of her. My mother has been been busy working since I was a baby, she even worked whilst pregnant with me.

I am aware of her hardships. However, I don't need strangers other than my mother coming into house.

After a while, the intercom rang. I fearfully opened the door to find a beautiful woman standing there.

"It's nice to meet you, you must be Ms. Mano's son." Mikoto Suzukara has been sent by the Home Helper Dispatch Association. Since she said she was a nanny, I thought she would be an old lady, or perhaps someone close to an old lady.

She had a more glamorous atmosphere than my mother, her boobs stood out more than my mother's, and she was dressed in a maid's . uniform.

I was already overwhelmed by her appearance alone, and I could do nothing but ogle. I can't be intimidated even though I live here...

"May I come in?"

I was not going to stand here for long, so I decided to invite her in anyway.

[From [url=https://www.spindle-game.com/spdl_020.html#scene]Official website[/url]]
